name: medium-research-github
description: GitHub research with normalized MCP output. Wraps the GitHub REST API (gh_trending_repos, gh_search_issues, gh_get_item) — trending repositories via the Search API (stars->score) and open issues for pain-point mining (reaction total->score, comments->num_comments). Runs fully anonymously; an optional GITHUB_TOKEN (PAT) raises rate limits (30 req/min search, 5000/hr core vs 10/60 anonymous) and is injected via the sensitive user_config field below (stored in the OS keychain, masked on input, never written to disk in plaintext). Actual .mcpb packing is deferred to v2 (PKG-01); this manifest is documentation/scaffold only.

github_token.title: GitHub personal access token
github_token.description: Optional — a fine-grained or classic PAT with public read scope raises GitHub API rate limits. The server runs anonymously without it. Create one at https://github.com/settings/tokens.
